Securities and Exchange Commission of
Sri Lanka
maintain an adequate level of capital in accordance
with the financial risks undertaken with regard to
the securities transactions that are to be cleared and
settled using its services;
undertake  financial  liability  within  the  limits
established in its rules and within the framework of
the guarantees to be taken from its clearing members
in the form of margins, charges and collateral;
establish  and  maintain  a  data  processing
infrastructure and other internal controls including
internal audit systems for risk management;
segregate the guarantees and the assets of account
holders  from  the  assets  of  the  licensed  clearing
house;
not  use  the  guarantees  or  assets  taken  from  its
clearing members for purposes other than those for
which they were deposited; and
act in the public interest having particular regard
to the need to protect investors.
